goal: Turn verified @imm-loop focus and priority comments into advisory leader hints, add the privileged steer_loop_work_item Host tool (pause, resume, abandon under native confirmation on Claude Code, Pi and Antigravity) applied by the daemon with a new abandoned terminal state, answer GitHub pause, resume and abandon commands with a notice only (retiring the daemon-wide comment pause per BR-DEC-11), gate paused and abandoned items out of every dispatch path, and show paused items and leader activity in imm-loop status --json, per D5 of docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-6; meet D5.1 in docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-daemon-config-comms.test.ts. Done looks like: verified @imm-loop focus <text> and @imm-loop priority <high|normal|low> comments become owner_hint journal entries that appear in the next leader briefing. Negative: a comment from a non-allowlisted author or an edited comment is ignored; a hint never changes WorkItem state. Bound: derived-output checks and typecheck pass.

Source BR-REQ-6, BR-REQ-5, BR-DEC-10, BR-DEC-11, BR-SCN-4; meet D5.2-D5.4 in docs/specs/loop-leader.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-leader-steering.test.ts, tests/loop-daemon-dispatch.test.ts, tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts and tests/canary-command-retirement-contract.test.ts. Done looks like: steer_loop_work_item pause, after native confirmation, marks the item paused on the next tick and imm-loop status --json shows it with leader last_wake_at and wakes_today; resume clears it; abandon moves it to abandoned. Negative: a denied native confirmation writes nothing; a paused or abandoned item whose Issue or PR keeps producing new facts (failing CI, ready-for-agent) gets no candidate from Tier-1/2 dispatch, the scheduler or leader dispatch and is recorded skipped with work_item_paused or work_item_abandoned; GitHub @imm-loop pause and resume comments get one notice naming the local action and change neither the item nor the daemon-wide state.paused; abandon leaves a running Kernel run untouched. Bound: steer_loop_work_item is in PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS and registered on Claude Code, Pi and Antigravity, with the pinned Pi tool list updated; local imm-loop pause still holds every dispatch.

scope_size_reason: A privileged Host tool must be listed in PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS and registered on every Host (MCP runtime, Pi extension with its pinned tool-list test); the per-item dispatch gate and the retired daemon-wide comment pause live in dispatch.ts; daemon apply, scheduler skip and status land together so a confirmed pause is never ignored.
